3240-5477-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Insidious Roots triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1662-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
1662-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Karoo
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-2079-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2511-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

480-728-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

1545-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

670-1619-3742-6137.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6137.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Barrowin of Clan Undurr to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Barrowin of Clan Undurr enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Barrowin of Clan Undurr trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Barrowin of Clan Undurr until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

4015-4377-7757.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn with {1}{R} each extra turn
4015-4377-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
4015-4377-7757.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Rift Elemental by paying {1}{R} and removing a time counter from Walk the Aeons.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3908-4006.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat each turn.

4452-5256-5659-6483.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dark Revenant.
When Dark Revenant dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Dark Revenant's power, which will cause you to mill Dark Revenant.
As Dark Revenant is a Lhurgoyf due to Rukarumel, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Dark Revenant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

864-4872-5144.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Eternal Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

225-539-1460-6844.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
225-539-1460-6844.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man 2099 trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Repeat.
225-539-1460-6844.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

2034-3490-6823-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6823-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1746-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2511-5571-6331--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1680-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-5572-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5572-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

791-3693-5427-5934.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5427-5934.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

304-1978-3941.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Tough Cookie.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

2862-3199-3209.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
2862-3199-3209.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a 3/3 Wraith creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2124-4052.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
"Knight" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
2034-2124-4052.description:
Activate Chivalric Alliance by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Knight, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3742-4681.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantom Steed, adding {C}{C}.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, exiling Karmic Guide until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Repeat.

2634-3593-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
2634-3593-4821.description:
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the copy of Dramatic Reversal, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana-producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1800-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Old Gnawbone does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent can not block Old Gnawbone.
An opponent can not block Hellkite Charger.
1800-3398.description:
Move to your combat step.
Attack with Hellkite Charger and Old Gnawbone.
When Hellkite Charger attacks, it triggers.
Pay {5}{R}{R}, adding an additional combat phase after this one.
Old Gnawbone triggers for each creature that dealt combat damage, creating a number of treasures equal to the damage dealt with each trigger.
Move to your additional combat step.
Attack with Hellkite Charger and Old Gnawbone.
When Hellkite Charger attacks, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
